families.protected_boundary: Existing source-specific old-path absence and replacement checks until generic manifest, authority, link, and Git-recoverability validation supersedes them.
families.removal_gate: Every protected old path has a generic retirement-manifest entry or reviewed current disposition, equivalent generic validation is green, and no current workflow consumer remains.

families.protected_boundary: Existing completion-report metadata profiles, required sections, source-PR evidence anchors, and unresolved-placeholder rejection. This family has no authority over Documentation Model prose, new-record creation, templates, active-document semantics, or retired-path detection.
families.removal_gate: All existing completion reports are synthesized, reclassified into allowlisted retained records, or retired to Git; no workflow, consolidated smoke group, evaluation runner, operator procedure, or current architecture document consumes the validator; and generic authority, retained-record, link, semantic-audit, and Git-recoverability checks protect every continuing invariant.

families.protected_boundary: Commit-fixed legacy classification, normative candidate extraction, and link-dependency evidence still referenced by unfinished source families.
current_consumers: bounded D2-D6 source-family synthesis and retirement reviews
families.removal_gate: All remaining sources are governed by the canonical active graph, generic normative extraction, generic link checks, and the retirement manifest.

families.protected_boundary: Legacy one-document cutover provenance until its durable fields are represented by the generic retirement manifest or an allowlisted retained record.
families.removal_gate: All continuing recovery or audit facts are represented by allowlisted records, and historical-only narratives remain recoverable from Git.

families.protected_boundary: Existing current-document consumers and historical compile/checkpoint provenance while canonical architecture and exact checkpoint authority move to responsibility-oriented paths.
current_consumers: current architecture and contract links that still reference the legacy compile/checkpoint paths
families.removal_gate: Every current consumer links directly to docs/architecture/runtime/compile-and-checkpoint.md and the owning contracts, the dedicated history pages have no current consumer, generic link and authority validation are green, and each removed path has a retirement-manifest entry.

families.protected_boundary: Remaining active architecture, contract, router, planning, reference, integration, and top-level documentation consumers while canonical component responsibility and target order move to docs/architecture/pipeline-responsibilities.md and narrower mode, compile/checkpoint, or domain owners.
current_consumers: bounded D2-B2b active consumer migration review
remaining active architecture, contract, router, planning, reference, integration, and top-level documentation links to the transitional pipeline responsibility path
families.removal_gate: Move every remaining consumer to docs/architecture/pipeline-responsibilities.md or the smallest mode, compile/checkpoint, configuration, integration, or domain authority; pass generic authority and link validation; and record the removal in the manifest.
